supported_scope: The App VCS pane can discard unstaged changes per file. Recovery coverage is limited to the documented file action.
unestablished_scope: Recovery of committed or deleted/untracked files
Rollback of terminal side effects, external actions or deployed resources
required_setup: Use the App Review pane on a Git-backed project and inspect changes before discarding.
constraints: Git worktrees separate working copies; they do not roll back external effects.
